question: Who won the Chess Esports World Cup (EWC) 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Magnus Carlsen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Carlsen Wins Inaugural Chess Esports World Cup in Riyadh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Magnus Carlsen** won the **first Chess Esports World Cup (EWC 2025)**.

 
 
• 
 
The tournament was held in **Riyadh**, Saudi Arabia.

 
 
• 
 
Carlsen represented **Team Liquid** and beat **Alireza Firouzja** of **Team Falcons**.

 
 
• 
 
Carlsen displayed **dominant form** in both classical and esports-style formats.

 
 
• 
 
He won the **$250,000 top prize** and helped **Team Liquid** lead the overall standings.

 
 
• 
 
In the third-place match, **GM Hikaru Nakamura** defeated **GM Arjun Erigaisi** **3.5–2.5**.

 
 
• 
 
The match between Nakamura and Arjun had **five decisive games out of six**.

 
 
• 
 
The event marks a major step in **esports-integrated competitive chess**.
